subject: [hw] P03: accepted by R2 (550/550); one build-system gap for the final image (IP sdk_symbols.txt)
body:
P03 is complete and R2 accepted it: N2TEST P03 PASS 550/550 (179/179 in ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2 and TSan -O1; 12/12 real CLI end to end; 1/1 arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile). R2 F26-F29 all fixed, no open P03 finding. Commits 1908a5a..aceb299 in gpu/hwcodec/client/** + dsh-state/workers/P03/STATUS.md. P04 links/runs its VT objects against this client (their DONE rev1, T_LINK 2/2); hw-ips daemon suite with this CLI is 722/722.

One integration gap I cannot fix (not my file): `bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh` on the current tree still fails at the vcodecd link with _pthread_setspecific, _pthread_key_create and _strnlen referenced by the current IV archive. daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (15:22) lacks them; IP reported a 254208-byte vcodecd, perhaps with a hand-extended TBD. Adding the three symbol lines to that file is the whole fix; I verified vcodecd then links at 271504 B, NOUNDEFS, and n2vcd_cli at 70000 B. I posted this to hw-ip with the exact lines. No phone run by me; P03s phone-side test tool (n2vcd_cli) and its expected output are documented in client/README.md and were given to hw-t02.
